label: Grandstream GRP2616
description: Grandstream GRP2616 carrier-grade six-line desk phone with two colour LCDs (4.3-inch main plus 2.4-inch extension), 16 SIP accounts and 48 virtual MPKs, aimed at hot-desking and BLF-heavy reception positions. Wired side is a pair of dual-switched 10/100/1000 ports with 802.3af PoE on the LAN port, and from hardware version 5.0 the phone also carries its own dual-band Wi-Fi 6 (2.4/5 GHz) and Bluetooth radios.
notes: Datasheet: 'Dual switched auto-sensing 10/100/1000 Mbps Gigabit Ethernet ports with integrated PoE' (two jacks, LAN plus PC), 'Integrated Power-over-Ethernet (802.3af)', 'Max power consumption 6.1 W (power adapter) or 7.8 W (PoE)'. Wi-Fi: 'Integrated dual-band (2.4GHz and 5GHz) Wi-Fi 6 (802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax) - hardware version 5.0 and above' - stream count is not published, so 1.2G models a 2x2 80 MHz ax link; Bluetooth is integrated but is not a network interface. USB port and RJ9 headset jack not modelled. Note the GRP2616 is the model that makes an otherwise all-wired phone estate look like it has a wireless client on the access point.
